Show assumptions and calculation

People × hours per person × reduction = potential weekly capacity. Weekly capacity × 52 ÷ 12 × hourly value = monthly capacity value.

The reduction is a scenario you choose, not an AI prediction. Capacity value is not guaranteed cash savings or additional revenue. Implementation, tools, maintenance and oversight costs are excluded. A workflow review checks what is realistic.
